flashcardContentBlock.content: What are the four operational states of the HardwareInterlockGate state machine?
.locked, .armed, .permissiveGranted, and .emergencyAbort.
What is the default initial operational status of HardwareInterlockGate upon instantiation?
.locked.
Which state transition occurs when arm() is called on a HardwareInterlockGate in the .locked state?
Transition to .armed (recorded with reason "ARM_COMMAND_ACCEPTED").
What happens if grantPermissive() is called directly on a HardwareInterlockGate while it is in the .locked state?
It throws HardwareInterlockError.invalidTransition(from: .locked, to: .permissiveGranted).
How does calling grantPermissive() affect callers suspended in requestPermissive() while the gate is .armed?
It transitions the gate to .permissiveGranted and drains all pending waiter continuations with success.
What is the mandatory state recovery target when calling resetEmergencyAbort() on an aborted gate?
It returns the gate strictly to the .locked state.
Which error is thrown if a caller attempts a direct transition from .emergencyAbort to .armed without calling resetEmergencyAbort()?
HardwareInterlockError.emergencyAbortActive.
What happens to callers suspended in requestPermissive() when tripEmergencyAbort() is invoked?
All pending waiters are drained immediately and throw HardwareInterlockError.emergencyAbortActive.
Calling requestPermissive() on a HardwareInterlockGate in the .locked state throws which error?
HardwareInterlockError.gateLocked.
What is the maximum capacity cap of the HardwareInterlockGate transition history ring buffer?
2048 records.
In ScramKCore, what is a PermissivePermit?
A cryptographically identified, request-bound, single-use capability token issued for a bounded execution window.
To which state does HardwareInterlockGate transition when issuePermissivePermit() is successfully invoked from .armed?
.permissiveGranted.
What state transition occurs automatically the instant consumePermissivePermit() succeeds?
The gate atomically relocks to .locked.
What occurs if a client attempts to reuse or replay an already consumed PermissivePermit?
The consumption attempt is rejected and throws HardwareInterlockError.gateLocked.
Which error is thrown when consumePermissivePermit() is called at or after the permit's expiresAt instant?
HardwareInterlockError.timedOut (and the active permit is cleared, relocking the gate).
How does consumePermissivePermit() enforce anti-hijacking between distinct tool requests?
It verifies that the requestID argument matches the requestID stored in the gate's activePermit.
Which property in PermissivePermit prevents a permit issued in a prior gate generation from being accepted after re-arming?
issuedStateVersion (which must match the gate's current stateVersion).
How many concurrent callers can successfully consume a single-use PermissivePermit?
Exactly one caller; all other competing threads or tasks are rejected.
What is the primary operational purpose of the environment scrubber in MCPProcessTransport?
To strip inherited host variables and prevent credential leakage or dynamic library injection in child processes.
Which seven environment keys form the explicit allowlist enforced by MCPProcessTransport?
PATH, HOME, USER, LOGNAME, TMPDIR, LANG, and LC_ALL.
To which exact directory list is PATH pinned by the 7-key environment scrubber?
/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin.
To which specific locale string are LANG and LC_ALL set in the scrubbed subprocess environment?
Name three dynamic linker or execution variables explicitly purged by the 7-key environment scrubber.
DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES, LD_PRELOAD, and BASH_ENV (also ENV, PROMPT_COMMAND, PYTHONSTARTUP, NODE_OPTIONS).
What is the primary function of the 1.5-second critical-read dwell guard in ScramKUI?
It enforces a mandatory inspection dwell time on high-risk intercepts before clearance controls unlock.
What is the default criticalReadGuardDuration in ActiveHoldPolicy?
1.5 seconds (1500 ms).
What is the default initial approval window duration configured in ActiveHoldPolicy?
5 seconds.
What is the hard upper limit for maxHoldDuration in ActiveHoldPolicy?
120 seconds.
Which user interface events cause an active dead-man hold to disengage and immediately relock?
Releasing the physical Space key, losing window key-focus, or deactivating the application.
How does ConsoleStateController mark the start of a dead-man hold-to-read sequence?
It sets isAuthorizationHoldActive = true and records holdStartedAt = ContinuousClock.now.
What happens to the remaining approval deadline if endAuthorizationHold() is called before the dwell guard completes?
The hold terminates and the deadline is clamped without granting permissive authorization.
What are the two defined execution profiles in ContainerSecurityProfile?
.strictAirgap and .loopbackFramebuffer.
How does the .strictAirgap profile enforce network isolation in Docker containers?
By applying --network=none at the kernel namespace level.
To which specific loopback address and port is .loopbackFramebuffer bound?
List three security flags enforced by ContainerSecurityProfile during container startup.
--read-only, --cap-drop=ALL, and --security-opt=no-new-privileges (along with --pids-limit 256 and --memory 4g).
What target platform version and Swift language mode are mandated for building scramkd?
macOS 14.0+ and Swift 6 language mode with complete strict concurrency (-strict-concurrency=complete).
Which framework dependencies are allowed inside the ScramKCore target?
Pure Swift and Foundation only; zero UI, audio, or virtualization dependencies are permitted.
What invariant must be observed when acquiring an OSAllocatedUnfairLock in ScramK code?
The lock must only protect synchronous, non-suspending critical sections and MUST NEVER be held across an await point.
Which isolation domain owns AppKit, SwiftUI views, view controllers, and presentation state?
@MainActor.
Under Swift 6 complete strict concurrency, what protocol conformance is required for values sent across isolation domains?
Sendable.
Why is WKWebView prohibited in ScramKUI?
To eliminate browser engine attack surface and enforce native SwiftUI, AppKit, and MetalKit component layouts.
How does MCPNonblockingWriter serialize POSIX pipe I/O without blocking Swift concurrency threads?
By writing 16 KiB F_SETNOSIGPIPE chunks through fenced write tickets.
How does ContainerSocketBridge verify wire payload SHA-256 hex digests without timing side-channels?
By using a constant-time byte-wise XOR accumulator comparison.
Which error is thrown by ContainerSocketBridge when an inbound payload SHA-256 digest fails constant-time comparison?
BridgeError.wrongHash.
Why does sending all request bytes into a pipe NOT constitute execution success?
Because pipe write completion does not verify remote processing or correlated response receipt.
Which operations are strictly prohibited inside the CScramKAudioRealtime audio render callback?
Locks, dynamic allocations, file/network I/O, Task creation, and actor or UI calls.
What four tactical audio cues are synthesized by ScramKToneSynthesizer?
interceptAlert, holdTick, grantConfirm, and abortSiren.
What exception permits ScramKAudio to import AVFoundation and CoreAudio?
Preserving on-device LocalVoiceCommander output without enabling microphone capture or automatic PTT.
What are the logical canvas dimensions governing the layout geometry of ScramKUI?
$1440 \times 900$ logical points.
Which components comprise Tier 1 of the 3-Tier Progressive Disclosure HUD?
The top 44pt interlock status banner, active profile badge, Display P3 MetalKit viewport, and primary SCRAM/Hold controls.
Which components comprise Tier 2 of the 3-Tier Progressive Disclosure HUD?
The actionable intercept summary card, risk badges (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL), intent summary, and 1.5s dwell guard.
Which components comprise Tier 3 of the 3-Tier Progressive Disclosure HUD?
The collapsible semantic JSON diff & provenance drawer, detailing raw SHA-256 digests and key-by-key diffs.
Which target color space pipeline is used for presentation rendering in ScramKUI?
Display P3.
Which local keycodes are monitored by scramkd for Space, Esc, and F12?
Keycode 49 (Space), Keycode 53 (Esc), and Keycode 111 (F12).
Which command is immediately executed when the operator presses the Esc key?
tripEmergencyAbort() (Emergency SCRAM trip).
What is displayed on the HUD control strip when F12 is pressed?
"F12 (NOT IMPLEMENTED)".
What three conditions must be met before F12 can report success in production?
Descriptor teardown, cryptographic zeroization of nonces/leases, and kernel fsync(2) log snapshot confirmation.
How does scramkd suppress repeated command triggers when a key is held down continuously?
By filtering out key-repeat events using an event timestamp/identifier token cache.
Do local key-monitors intercept Space/Esc key events when an AppKit text field has active focus?
No; active text focus retains key events for text editing and navigation.
What is the executable target for the operator CLI in the scramkd repository?
scramkctl.
What subcommands are supported by the scramkctl CLI?
status, grant, abort (or scram/trip), and --help.
Which process exit code is returned by scramkctl when given an unknown command argument?
Exit status 64.
Where is the default Unix domain control socket file path defined in com.scramk.daemon.plist?
/var/run/scramkd/control.sock.
Which loopback telemetry endpoint is configured in com.scramk.daemon.plist?
What is the row limit for the in-memory audit log array in ConsoleStateController?
256 rows (auditRowLimit).
How does ConsoleStateController alert the user when older audit log rows have been truncated?
By prepending a persistent truncation marker row displaying the count of omitted transitions/rows.
Which subsystem label is assigned to transition audit records emitted directly by HardwareInterlockGate?
"INTERLOCK".
What tag color is assigned to .emergencyAbort transitions in the console audit log?
Red ("red").
Which command executes complete strict concurrency compilation for scramkd release targets?
swift build -c release -Xswiftc -strict-concurrency=complete
Which specific test case is skipped during standard offline CI suite execution?
'ContainerSocketBridgeTests.testLiveContainerHandshakeUnderPermissiveGateState'
Does triggering an emergency SCRAM abort guarantee immediate container destruction?
No; interlock state reflects local gate authorization, not verified Docker container destruction or VM teardown.
What role is played by ContinuationWaiter in ScramKCore?
It uses an OSAllocatedUnfairLock to guarantee exactly-once resumption of checked continuations.
What is the maximum JSON nesting depth allowed during dispatchMCPCommand payload validation?
32 levels (exceeding depth throws BridgeError.limitExceeded(.jsonDepth)).
What requirement governs C11 lock-free publication in CScramKAudioRealtime?
FFI boundaries must feature lock-free atomic publication and quiescent destruction without thread suspension.
Why is an unverified caller-supplied PID or agent identity string marked as UNKNOWN?
To prevent prompt-injected or untrusted container processes from falsifying provenance in audit logs.
What is the maximum buffer chunk size read per step during stdio MCP process transport?
16 KiB (16,384 bytes).
